## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The `BULLET_HINT` rewording is accurate. The new `CRITERION_HINT` contradicts the `require_shall` option that this PR keeps, so users who turn that option on are told to write criteria that the validator will reject. Fix that before merging.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/criteria.py:1 — correctness — The hint now always reads "Write criteria as direct action bullets without the word shall.", but `accepts_criterion` at `app/criteria.py:7-8` still returns `" shall " in text` when `require_shall=True`. A user who follows the hint and writes `- Save the result` gets a rejection under that option; `tests/test_criteria.py:21` asserts this rejection. Could the hint depend on `require_shall`, for example a second hint constant chosen by the caller, or could it drop the "without the word shall" clause so it holds under both options? — With `require_shall: true` (`config.example.yml:1` exposes the option), every criterion written the way the hint says fails validation, and the hint gives the user no way to fix it.

## Suggestions
(none)

## Strengths
- The new `BULLET_HINT` (`app/criteria.py:12`) gives the exact prefix `- `. That matches the `text.startswith("- ")` check at `app/criteria.py:5`.
